en.headline: LPG tanker overturns in Tsing Yi, two men injured
en.dek: The vehicle carrying about eight tonnes of liquefied petroleum gas flipped at a roundabout early on Tuesday; both occupants climbed out conscious.
body: An LPG tanker carrying about eight tonnes of liquefied petroleum gas overturned in Tsing Yi early on Tuesday morning, leaving the driver and passenger injured.

The incident occurred at 1.33am when the vehicle, travelling along Hong Wan Road towards Kowloon, lost control while turning at Roundabout No. 3 and flipped onto its side. The driver and passenger were briefly trapped before climbing out.

Firefighters were deployed with hoses on standby. Both men were conscious but had bleeding injuries to their hands and feet. The passenger was taken to hospital by ambulance while the driver refused hospitalisation after treatment.
Police are investigating the cause, including whether excessive speed was a factor. A section of Hong Wan Road towards Tsing Yi was temporarily closed.

zh.headline: 青衣石油氣罐車翻側 司機及乘客受傷
zh.dek: 載有約八噸石油氣的罐車周二凌晨在康宏路迴旋處失控翻側，兩人自行爬出，乘客送院治理。
body: 一輛載有約八噸石油氣的罐車周二凌晨在青衣翻側，司機及乘客受傷。
事故於凌晨1時33分發生，車輛沿康宏路往九龍方向行駛，在三號迴旋處轉彎時失控翻側。司機及乘客一度被困，其後自行爬出。
消防到場戒備。兩人清醒但手腳有出血傷勢，乘客由救護車送院，司機經治理後拒絕送院。
警方正調查事故原因，包括是否超速，康宏路往青衣方向一段暫時封閉。
